source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Μείραξ και διήγησις πάνυ ωφέλιμος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The day's line carries «και διήγησις πάνυ ωφέλιμος», and a most profitable narrative, which is the title of the reading and not a second commemoration. The page gives no year and names no emir but the title Ἀμηρᾶς, so no `dates` object. Tenese in Egypt is named; no coordinate is proposed. The corpus holds nobody of this name. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
